title: bash-guard policy
description: Repo-specific parameters for the vendored bash-guard.sh. Everything here is per-repo; the guard core is identical across repos. Strict defaults apply when a key (or the whole file) is absent: an absent policy never weakens the guard.

agent_may_merge.description: Whether the agent may merge a PR whose base is the integration branch. A merge whose base is the protected branch is ALWAYS denied (human-only), regardless of this flag. false → the agent may not merge any PR (e.g. trunk→main repos, where the only base is the protected branch).

require_pr_label.description: Whether `gh pr create` must carry --label: the release gate of the studio products reads a semver label from the PR. false only in a repository whose releases do not read PR labels (e.g. release-please from the commits). The waiver covers PRs in THIS repository only: one opened toward another repository, or whose target the guard cannot prove, still needs the label.

protected_branch.description: The reviewed/released line. Direct push is forbidden and merging a PR into it is human-only. Universal value 'main' in this fleet.

integration_branch.description: The live integration branch a merge may target when agent_may_merge is true (e.g. 'develop' for the products). Empty for trunk→main repos.

generated_trees.description: Paths of auto-generated trees that must not be hand-edited (e.g. a Prisma output dir). Empty → all generated-tree checks are skipped (short-circuit: an empty tree must never match every write).

generated_regen_hint.description: The command/instruction to regenerate the tree, shown in the deny message (e.g. 'edit schema.prisma and run pnpm build').

egress_allow.description: Hosts curl/wget may reach. Universal policy: network egress is restricted to this allow-list in every repo. Extend per-repo only with a ratified reason.

set_phase_cmd.description: How sdd-gate.sh names the sanctioned phase mutator in its deny messages. Absent → it names the core-dev plugin's scripts/opsx/set-phase.sh, which is the right answer for a repo on the plugin-only engine. Set it only where the repo still vendors its own mutator and the deny must point somewhere else.

reserved_paths.description: Surfaces this repo reserves to the owner ON TOP of the built-in floor of the pr-score gate (skills/pr-score/scripts/reserved-surface.sh). A PR that touches one is escalated instead of auto-merged. The floor itself cannot be configured away. Globs match the repo-relative path; `**` crosses directories, `*` does not.

why.description: The surface, in a few words; shown next to the path when the gate escalates.

reserved_paths_hard.description: Like reserved_paths, but HARD: these paths stay the owner's even when the repo opts into the owner-decision lens (owner_lens), where an independent reviewer decides by content whether a change on the rest of the reserved surface needs the owner. Checked by `reserved-surface.sh --hard-only` together with the built-in hard subset (the guard and hooks, the merge-gate scripts, the guard policy, the agent's cabling, security/, the data model). Also reserved in the default mode, so a caller that never passes the flag cannot merge over them. Absent → only the built-in hard subset.

why.description: The surface, in a few words; shown next to the path when the gate escalates.

owner_lens.description: Opt-in to the owner-decision lens (skills/owner-decision). false or absent → nothing changes: every hit of reserved-surface.sh escalates, as always. true → the merge procedure asks an independent, fresh-context reviewer whether the change contains a decision that belongs to the owner, and gates on its verdict with skills/pr-score/scripts/owner-gate.py; a path hit in the hard subset (reserved-surface.sh --hard-only) still goes to the owner always, a path hit outside it proceeds only if the lens finds nothing.

pr_score.description: Thresholds for the pr-score gate (scripts/gate.py). Absent → strict defaults (total_min 22, axis_min 4). Merge permission is NOT here — it is agent_may_merge above, which the gate also honors (false → a passing score still escalates to the human).

total_min.description: Minimum sum across the 5 axes (each 1-5, max 25) for an auto-merge verdict.

axis_min.description: Minimum score every single axis must reach for an auto-merge verdict.
